results.title: Han Ho-san, Korean-born coach behind German judo's golden era, dies at 88
results.description: Han Ho-san, the Korean-born former Germany national judo coach who guided generations of medal-winning athletes, has died at 88.

results.title: Mark Rydell, actor-turned-director behind On Golden Pond, who straddled studio and New Hollywood eras
results.description: Mark Rydell, who has died aged 97, was an American actor-turned-director who straddled the divide between the studio era and the New Hollywood that followed, refusing to pick sides. He filmed John Wayne being shot in the back for The Cowboys (1972); in his role as gangster Marty Augustine in Robert Altman’s The Long Goodbye (1973), he was seen to smash a Coke bottle into his girlfriend’s face.
